test_autotokenizer_from_pretrained: test loading a pretrained tokenizer from the HuggingFace Hub using AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained
test_tokenizer_type_selection: test loading a slow or fast tokenizer by passing use_fast to AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained
test_custom_tokenizer_registration: test registering a custom tokenizer class with AutoTokenizer.register for a new model config
test_dynamic_tokenizer_loading: test loading a dynamic tokenizer from a remote repo using trust_remote_code=True
test_tokenizer_config_retrieval: test retrieving the tokenizer config dict for a model using get_tokenizer_config
